title: Evolver: Turning Agent Exploration into Evolving Capabilities
abstract: arXiv:2611.07595v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent exploration produces valuable procedural knowledge, yet much of this experience remains confined to transient execution traces and is not systematically reused. We introduce Evolver, an experience-driven framework that transforms agent exploration into persistent, reusable capabilities without updating foundation model parameters. Built around structured Gene assets, Evolver integrates experience acquisition, retrieval, and feedback-guided evolution to support experience-conditioned execution across existing agent harnesses. We evaluate Evolver using Claude Code and Codex, two foundation model configurations, and four benchmarks: Terminal-Bench 2.1, SWE-bench Multilingual, SWE-rebench, and GAIA. On a selected diagnostic set of 320 paired executions, Evolver improves task success from 83.13% to 87.50% (+4.38 percentage points) while reducing recorded task-execution token consumption by 24.24%. translated_title: Evolver：将智能体探索转化为不断演进的能力
translated_abstract: 智能体探索会产生有价值的程序性知识，然而这些经验大多仍局限于瞬态的执行轨迹中，未能被系统性地复用。我们提出 Evolver，一个经验驱动的框架，它能够在不更新基础模型参数的前提下，将智能体探索转化为持久且可复用的能力。Evolver 以结构化的 Gene 资产为核心，集成了经验获取、检索以及反馈引导的演化机制，从而在现有智能体框架中支持基于经验的条件化执行。我们使用 Claude Code 和 Codex 两种基础模型配置，以及 Terminal-Bench 2.1、SWE-bench Multilingual、SWE-rebench 和 GAIA 四个基准测试对 Evolver 进行了评估。在一个包含 320 组配对执行的诊断集上，Evolver 将任务成功率从 83.13% 提升至 87.50%（提高 4.38 个百分点），同时将记录的任务执行 token 消耗降低了 24.24%。此外，在 265 组成功……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Evolver 是一个无需更新基础模型参数的经验驱动框架，它通过结构化的 Gene 资产将智能体探索产生的经验转化为持久可复用的能力，在四个基准测试中显著提升任务成功率并将执行 token 消耗降低约 24%。
en_tdlr: Evolver is an experience-driven framework that transforms agent exploration into persistent, reusable capabilities through structured Gene assets—without updating foundation model parameters—improving task success rates while cutting execution token consumption by about 24% across four benchmarks.
